content:
Aisha (CS): Heads-up — planning a 3-day Spark Sessions enablement for high-touch renewal accounts next month. Looking for slot volunteers and timezone coverage. Proposed pattern: two consecutive weeks, Tue/Wed/Thu. Objectives: migration checklist, cost/latency tuning, runbook handover. Priority: Q1 renewal cohort.
Marco (CS): Love it. Can we do 2pm-4pm PT / 9-11pm GMT overlap for EMEA? Also please include a mini track for Dedicated customers.
Priya (Solutions): I can lead the Dedicated migration clinic. Prefer Wed mornings CET. Will need sample config and prework materials.
Devon (PM): FYI renewal list is in the drive (link). Suggest reserving first-day slots for customers flagged as "at-risk" by health score — easier to triage early.
Aisha (CS): Creating a poll for slot options now — choose all that work. Quick note: want 60min hands-on + 30min Q&A per slot. Also need facilitator pairs for each slot.
scheduler-bot: Poll created — https://polls.redwood/spark-sessions (expires in 72h) :calendar:
Liam (CS): Volunteering for an APAC-friendly slot (UTC+8). I can cover Tue/Thu local mornings. Will confirm exact hours after poll.
Marco (CS): Can we add prework: run a small inference test with a sample prompt and paste token/latency numbers in the prework form. I can draft a 1-pager.
Aisha (CS): Draft agenda (skeleton):
- 10 min intro & goals
- 25 min migration checklist walkthrough
- 40 min hands-on (guided lab)
- 15 min cost/quantization tips
- 20 min open Q/A
Pre-req: share model, peak seq length, and traffic shape. Quick prework snippet: 
```
# prework quick test
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
  -d '{"model":"gpt-xl", "input":"<10 sample prompts>", "max_tokens":64}'
```
Priya (Solutions): LGTM. I'll add a short post-session feedback form (NPS + 3 quick prompts) and attach it to the calendar invites.
Liam (CS): :thumbsup: please keep sessions under 2 hours. Also recommend inviting an SRE on-call for any infra questions during the hands-on.
Devon (PM): I'll tier the renewal list into 3 priority buckets and share the CSV by EOD so we can seed the calendar invites correctly.
Aisha (CS): Thanks all — I'll consolidate volunteers and finalize the poll results by noon tomorrow. If you can annotate the poll with preferred timezones, that helps scheduling. :sparkles:
